entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can improve your bestial form by enhancing it with the abilities of another animal.

Prerequisite(s): Chimeric aspect class feature, wild shape class feature.

Benefit(s): When you transform using the wild shape ability, you can gain the abilities of one of the minor forms of another of your chosen aspects as well.
